SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID id, FINPROD_ABBR text, fpt.TYPE_8 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_9 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_10 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_11 || '/' || fpt.TYPE_12 as object FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp left join fin_product_type fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE P_FINPROD_ID is null and (FINPROD_TYPE2 ='F01' or (FINPROD_TYPE2='F18' and fpt.type_9 IN('08','09'))
or FINPROD_TYPE2='F07'
)
and (fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or fp.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and (fp.FINPROD_ABBR=#{initValue} or fp.FINPROD_ID =#{initValue})

SELECT fp.FINPROD_ID finprodId, fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, fp.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, fp.FINPROD_NAME finprodName, fpt.type_8 type8, fpt.type_9 type9, fpt.type_10 type10, fpt.type_11 type11, fpt.type_12 type12 FROM FIN_PRODUCT fp left join fin_product_type fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=fpt.FINPROD_ID WHERE P_FINPROD_ID is null and (fpt.type_8 ='F01' or (fpt.type_8='F06' and fpt.type_9 IN('08','09')))
and (fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%') or fp.FINPROD_ABBR like concat(concat('%',#{search}),'%'))
and (fp.FINPROD_ABBR=#{initValue} or fp.FINPROD_ID =#{initValue})

SELECT DISTINCT REP_ASSET_CODE id, REP_ASSET_CODE text FROM REP_BOTTOM_ASSET
REP_ASSET_CODE LIKE CONCAT('%',CONCAT(#{search},'%'))

select ci.ORG_ASSET_TYPE2 assettypeTwo,ci.ORG_ASSET_TYPE3 assettypeThree, ci.ORG_ASSET_TYPE4 assettypeFour,ci.ORG_ASSET_TYPE5 assettypeFive, T.POS_AMT scaleG06,T.POS_AMT scalePbc,T.POS_NUM value, decode(CI.MDATE,null,null,(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE})/365) avgDuration,
case when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=0 then '01' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>0 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=30 then '02' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>30 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=90 then '03' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>90 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=180 then '04' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>180 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=360 then '05' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>360 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=720 then '06' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>720 and nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)<=1080 then '07' when nvl(CI.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE},0)>1080 then '08' end deadline
from CHB_BOT_AST_POS t left join CHB_ASSET_INFO ci on T.ASSET_CODE=CI.ASSET_CODE where t.plan_asset_id = #{assetcode, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and t.pos_date =#{cdate, jdbcType = DATE} and t.asset_code not in (select b.finprod_market_id from RSK_VALTBL_ASSET_SUB a inner join fin_product b on a.finprod_id = b.finprod_id where a.VAL_DATE = #{cdate, jdbcType = DATE} and a.finprod_id is not null) and t.status in ('E', 'M')

select FPT.TYPE_9 assettypeTwo,FPT.TYPE_10 assettypeThree,FPT.TYPE_11 assettypeFour,FPT.TYPE_12 assettypeFive, sum(smv) scalePbc,FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetcode from rsk_valtbl_asset_sub rvas left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on FP.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on FPT.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID where RVAS.FINPROD_ID is not null and fpt.type_9 !='12' and RVAS.PTL_ID=#{assetcode, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and RVAS.VAL_DATE=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} and RVAS.sub_code not like '1203%' and RVAS.sub_code not like '1204%' group by FPT.TYPE_9, FPT.TYPE_10, FPT.TYPE_11, FPT.TYPE_12, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID

with facevalue as( SELECT FINPROD_ID, INT_PRIN_AMT FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.FINPROD_ID order by vdate desc) my_rank , brating.FINPROD_ID , brating.INT_PRIN_AMT FROM fin_CASH_plan brating left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on brating.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F01' and vdate<=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} ) WHERE my_rank=1 ) select DISTINCT FPT.TYPE_9 assettypeTwo,FPT.TYPE_10 assettypeThree,FPT.TYPE_11 assettypeFour,FPT.TYPE_12 assettypeFive, decode(fp.FINPROD_TYPE2,'F01',nvl(SECURITY_QUANTITY,0)*nvl(facevalue.INT_PRIN_AMT,100),nvl(SECURITY_QUANTITY,0)) value,FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetcode from rsk_valtbl_asset_sub rvas left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on FP.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on FPT.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join facevalue on facevalue.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID where RVAS.FINPROD_ID is not null and fpt.type_9 !='12' and RVAS.PTL_ID=#{assetcode, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and RVAS.VAL_DATE=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} and RVAS.sub_code not like '1203%' and RVAS.sub_code not like '1204%'

with plan as( SELECT FINPROD_ID, EXERCISE_DATE FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.FINPROD_ID order by EXERCISE_DATE ) my_rank , brating.FINPROD_ID , brating.EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN brating where EXERCISE_DATE>=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} ) WHERE my_rank=1) ,enddays as( select fp.FINPROD_ID,nvl(ffp.mdate,fp.mdate) mdate from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT ffp on ffp.FINPROD_ID=fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 in ('F05','F06','F03') UNION ALL select ftp.FINPROD_ID,ftp.mdate from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on ftp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 in ('F07','F08','F10','F12') UNION ALL select fp.FINPROD_ID,decode(to_char(fp.mdate,'yyyyMM'),'2099',date'2099-01-01',fp.mdate) from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F04' UNION ALL select fp.FINPROD_ID,decode(fp.IS_RIGHT,'Y',nvl(plan.EXERCISE_DATE,fp.mdate),fp.mdate) from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID left join plan on PLAN.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F01' ) ,duration as( SELECT SEC_ID, M_DURATION FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.SEC_ID order by VALUE_DATE desc ) my_rank , brating.SEC_ID , brating.M_DURATION FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO brating where VALUE_DATE<=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} and VALUE_SOURCE='CBC' ) WHERE my_rank=1 ) ,duration1 as( SELECT SEC_ID, M_DURATION FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.SEC_ID order by VALUE_DATE desc ) my_rank , brating.SEC_ID , brating.M_DURATION FROM MST_BOND_VALUATION_INFO brating where VALUE_DATE<=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} and VALUE_SOURCE='CSD' ) WHERE my_rank=1 ), mduration as( select DISTINCT nvl(fpp.FINPROD_ID,fp.FINPROD_ID) FINPROD_ID,(ENDDAYS.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE})/365 mDuration from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT fpp on fpp.FINPROD_ID=FP.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on nvl(fpp.FINPROD_ID,fp.FINPROD_ID)=FPT.FINPROD_ID left join enddays on fp.FINPROD_ID=ENDDAYS.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 in ('F08','F10','F05','F03','F12','F06') UNION all select fp.FINPROD_ID,decode(fp.TRADE_MARKET,'01',nvl(duration.M_DURATION,(ENDDAYS.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE})/365),nvl(duration1.M_DURATION,(ENDDAYS.MDATE-#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE})/365)) mDuration from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID left join duration on duration.SEC_ID=fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join duration1 on duration1.SEC_ID=fp.FINPROD_MARKET_ID left join enddays on fp.FINPROD_ID=ENDDAYS.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F01' )
select DISTINCT FPT.TYPE_9 assettypeTwo,FPT.TYPE_10 assettypeThree, FPT.TYPE_11 assettypeFour,FPT.TYPE_12 assettypeFive, mduration.mduration avgDuration,FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetcode from rsk_valtbl_asset_sub rvas left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on FP.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on FPT.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join mduration on mduration.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID where RVAS.FINPROD_ID is not null and fpt.type_9 !='12' and RVAS.PTL_ID=#{assetcode, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and RVAS.VAL_DATE=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} and RVAS.sub_code not like '1203%' and RVAS.sub_code not like '1204%'

with plan as( SELECT FINPROD_ID, EXERCISE_DATE FROM (SELECT row_number() over (partition BY brating.FINPROD_ID order by EXERCISE_DATE ) my_rank , brating.FINPROD_ID , brating.EXERCISE_DATE FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN brating where EXERCISE_DATE>=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} ) WHERE my_rank=1) ,enddays as( select fp.FINPROD_ID,nvl(ffp.mdate,fp.mdate) mdate from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT ffp on ffp.FINPROD_ID=fp.P_FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 in ('F05','F06','F03') UNION ALL select ftp.FINPROD_ID,ftp.mdate from FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on ftp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 in ('F07','F08','F10','F12') and fpt.type_9 !='12' UNION ALL select fp.FINPROD_ID,decode(to_char(fp.mdate,'yyyyMM'),'2099',date'2099-01-01',fp.mdate) from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F04' UNION ALL select fp.FINPROD_ID,decode(fp.IS_RIGHT,'Y',nvl(plan.EXERCISE_DATE,fp.mdate),fp.mdate) from FIN_PRODUCT fp left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on fp.FINPROD_ID=FPT.FINPROD_ID left join plan on PLAN.FINPROD_ID=fp.FINPROD_ID where fpt.type_8 = 'F01' ) select case when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=0 then '01' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>0 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=30 then '02' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>30 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=90 then '03' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>90 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=180 then '04' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>180 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=360 then '05' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>360 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=720 then '06' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>720 and nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)<=1080 then '07' when nvl(enddays.mdate-RVAS.VAL_DATE,0)>1080 then '08' end deadline,assettypeFive,shareamt,assetcode
from( select FPT.TYPE_9 assettypeTwo,FPT.TYPE_10 assettypeThree, FPT.TYPE_11 assettypeFour,FPT.TYPE_12 assettypeFive, sum(smv) shareamt,FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID assetcode,rvas.FINPROD_ID,RVAS.VAL_DATE from rsk_valtbl_asset_sub rvas left join FIN_PRODUCT fp on FP.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE fpt on FPT.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID where RVAS.FINPROD_ID is not null and fpt.type_9 !='12' and RVAS.PTL_ID=#{assetcode, jdbcType = VARCHAR} and RVAS.VAL_DATE=#{reportDate, jdbcType = DATE} group by FPT.TYPE_9, FPT.TYPE_10, FPT.TYPE_11, FPT.TYPE_12, FP.FINPROD_MARKET_ID,rvas.FINPROD_ID,RVAS.VAL_DATE ) rvas left join enddays on enddays.FINPROD_ID=rvas.FINPROD_ID
